raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 12 was delivered twice, at 02:00 and again at 05:00. The 05:00 copies of 345 txn_ids have txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, which breaks the TIMESTAMP cast. 1768543211000 ms is 2026-01-16 06:00:11 UTC, exactly the original copy's timestamp, and no other column differs. The fix is to parse both timestamp formats and keep one row per txn_id, preferring the earliest ingest.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH parsed AS (SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, ingest_ts, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]{13}$') THEN epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) ELSE TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'), dedup AS (SELECT * FROM parsed QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts ASC) = 1) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM dedup"}}
